title: Console telemetry rediscovery and remediation after capacity regression
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Summary: During the 2025-11-18 capacity regression (root cause: autoscaler race + sudden token burst), the Console failed to surface key telemetry that would have shortened the mean time to detection and resolution. Missing/insufficient signals included: per-model P99 latency percentiles split by backend variant, a KV-cache hit/miss metric exposed at the request-level, an end-to-end trace that includes the smart-routing decision and downstream fallback, and an aggregated token-backlog gauge for queueing-induced latency. Dashboards prioritized average latency and token throughput which masked tail latency and routing-induced errors. This ticket collects the remediation work and follow-ups from the incident postmortem.
action_items: A1: Add per-model and per-variant latency histogram metrics (p50/p95/p99) to the serving runtime and expose via metrics API - owner: Ravi Kapoor - estimate: 3 - status: In Progress
A2: Instrument KV-cache with request-scoped hit/miss counters and latency buckets; wire those to Console dashboard and SLO alerts - owner: Priya Nair - estimate: 2 - status: Planned

A3: Create a composed trace that spans API gateway -> router -> model runtime -> fallback path; add a dedicated trace span for 'routing.decision' with chosen_variant and reason tags - owner: Lena Cho - estimate: 3 - status: In Review
A4: Implement a token_backlog gauge aggregated per-region and per-queue; add alert when backlog growth rate > 200 tokens/s sustained for 2m - owner: Marco Silva - estimate: 2 - status: Planned

A5: Redesign Console latency overview tile to surface tail latency anomalies and include deviation from baseline; add drilldown links to per-model dashboards - owner: Design team (DES-412) - estimate: 2 - status: Backlog
A6: Add runbook and PagerDuty play for capacity regressions that references the new metrics and dashboards - owner: SRE - estimate: 1 - status: Planned
A7: Schedule a one-week audit to validate dashboard coverage against recent incident playbook and produce a missing-metric heatmap - owner: Observability Squad - estimate: 1 - status: In Progress
acceptance_criteria: All new metrics emitted with stable names and documented in metrics catalog
Console exposes per-model p99 latency and KV-cache hit/miss metrics with 1m scrape granularity
End-to-end trace demonstrates routing decision and fallback in test harness and sample production traces
Token backlog alerts fire in staging under synthetic burst and migration to production verified
Dashboard changes reviewed by PM and Design and added to Console release notes
